description: Returns a one-time link to a BuzzMeBro page that sends the person to Stripe’s own secure page, where THEY confirm their identity and add their bank. You never see or type bank details. Payouts start once they have at least $25 ready. First-time setup only: once payouts work, payout changes are made by the partner on their signed-in dashboard. The partner gets a text whenever this link is made.

partner_key.description: The partner key from partner_claim_key. On REST send it as "Authorization: Bearer <key>" instead.

name: partner_payout_link
title: Link for the person to add their bank on Stripe
